say:1:1623469001:1.text: Thanks for showing up. If you're here, you probably care about what's right, so I appreciate that!
say:1:1623469001:1.source_cn: 感谢今天能到场的朋友，想必你们都是内心极其有正义感的人...

say:2:1623469002:1.text: He hasn't even finished the first sentence and the crowd is already clapping hard.
say:2:1623469002:1.source_cn: 巴布的开场白没说完，台下的掌声就热烈地响了起来。

say:3:1623469003:1.text: Lately, we've seen too many stories tearing into students with damaged mana. Calling them "failures", saying they "deserved it", turning their pain into something people gossip about over afternoon tea.
say:3:1623469003:1.source_cn: 在过去的一段时间里，我们看到了太多针对魔力受损者的不公...

say:4:1623469004:1.text: But today, I'm saying it straight. This was never their fault!
say:4:1623469004:1.source_cn: 但今天，在这里，我要说——这从来不是他们的错！

say:5:1623469005:1.text: How many nights have you laid awake thinking, if my magic was just a little stronger... would I've passed that selection? Would I be standing in the royal court right now?
say:5:1623469005:1.source_cn: 我们是否曾无数次在深夜思索——如果自己的魔力再强一点、...

say:6:1623469006:1.text: But is that desperation really because we're born not good enough? Or did something make us feel like we're always behind, always failing?
say:6:1623469006:1.source_cn: 可在这份近乎绝望的渴望背后，真的是我们与生俱来的无能吗...

say:7:1623469007:1.text: Magic has no limits. But every time we use it, it takes something from us. It's like a poison that corrodes us from the inside!
say:7:1623469007:1.source_cn: 魔力的增长没有上限，而我们的内心却被它不断掏空——因为...

say:8:1623469008:1.text: The tough competition at the Lyceum isn't protecting us. It's speeding up that corrosion!
say:8:1623469008:1.source_cn: 而莱希拉姆的残酷竞争制度，非但没有成为我们的护盾，反而...

say:9:1623469009:1.text: This anxiety about magic isn't something students should be dealing with on their own.
say:9:1623469009:1.source_cn: 魔法焦虑，其根源不应由年轻的学生独自背负。

say:10:1623469010:1.text: The real problem is the system. It says it's supposed to motivate us, but all it does is push us into cutthroat competition!
say:10:1623469010:1.source_cn: 真正的症结，在于这座学校所推行的、那种看似激励实则无情...

say:12:1623469011:0.text: The audience erupts in applause as Bel finishes speaking. The students cheer his name, hailing him as a hero who has awakened them. He stands above them, looking down at the fervent crowd with pride.
say:12:1623469011:0.source_cn: 演讲至此，台下掌声雷动，学生们高呼着巴布的名字，他宛如...

say:14:1623469012:1.text: The students fire questions at Bel, and he handles them effortlessly. His words stir up even more anger toward magic, fanning the flames of their growing resentment.
say:14:1623469012:1.source_cn: 学生们疯狂地向巴布提问，他应对自如，带有诱惑感的言论让...

say:16:1623469013:2.text: When the host announces that Olaya, the founder of the support group, will be attending the next seminar as a special guest, the crowd cheers again.
say:16:1623469013:2.source_cn: 当主持人宣布，互助团队发起人奥莱雅将以特邀嘉宾的身份出...

say:18:1623469014:1.text: But you notice something strange—Bel slips off the stage before the seminar ends. You decide to follow him, curious about what he's up to.
say:18:1623469014:1.source_cn: 但你敏锐地注意到，巴布并未等研讨会结束就悄悄从台上离开...
say:18:1623469014:1.male: But you notice something strange—Bel slips off the stage before the seminar ends. You decide to follow him, curious about what he's up to.
say:18:1623469014:1.female: But you notice something strange—Bel slips off the stage before the seminar ends. You decide to follow him, curious about what he's up to.
